content.title: 'Laguna Beach' Reunion Special Set for Roku Channel: 10 Original Cast Members Returning! - IMDb
content.text: 'Laguna Beach' Reunion Special Set for Roku Channel: 10 Original Cast Members Returning!The cast of Laguna Beach is officially reuniting.The Reunion: Laguna Beach will start streaming on The Roku Channel on April 10, bringing back several original cast members for a new special more than 20 years after the MTV reality series first premiered.Keep reading to find out more…Returning for the reunion are: Lauren Conrad, Stephen Colletti, Kristin Cavallari, Lo Bosworth, Talan Torriero, Trey Phillips, Christina Shuller, Dieter Schmitz, Jessica Smith, Alex Hooser, and Morgan Smith.Original series creator Liz Gateley is also attached as an executive producer alongside several cast members.Here’s a synopsis: “The beloved cast will celebrate the nostalgia, friendships, and coastal backdrop that continues to captivate audiences to this day.See full article at Just Jared2/26/2026by Just JaredJust JaredSimilar NewsLauren ConradThe Drew Barrymore Show “Lauren Conrad” S6E276 April 15 2026 on CBS4/15/2026by Jamie BrooksTV Regular‘Laguna Beach’: Stephen Colletti Reflects on Lauren Conrad Friendship After High School & More (Video)4/9/2026TV Insider‘Laguna Beach’ Creator Reveals How Teen Cast Got Away With Drinking on Camera4/7/2026TV InsiderKristin CavallariWhere Are They Now?
